title: VMware vSphere or Proxmox VE: Rethinking Virtualisation After the Broadcom Licensing Changes
excerpt: Many organisations are reviewing their hypervisor after Broadcom changed VMware licensing. This comparison sets the established enterprise platform against the open-source alternative that has gained the most attention.
verdict: vSphere still makes sense for large organisations with the budget, existing skills and support contracts, and workloads that depend on its ecosystem. Proxmox VE is a capable, fast-growing alternative with no licence fee and optional paid support, and it is well worth a pilot for small and mid-sized environments, especially those facing higher VMware renewal costs.
